// Home paths, checkouts and Git-history paths in strings and templates, read
// as written and as evaluated. A line ending in "// flagged" must be
// reported; every other line must pass.
const plainString = '/home/me/repo'; // flagged
const escapedString = '\x2fhome/me/repo'; // flagged
const macString = '/Users/me/repo'; // flagged
const plainTemplate = `/home/me/repo`; // flagged
const escapedTemplate = `\x2fhome/me/repo`; // flagged
const escapedSlashes = `\x2fhome\x2fme\x2frepos`; // flagged
const unicodeTemplate = `/Users/me/repo`; // flagged
const rawTemplate = String.raw`/home/me/repo`; // flagged
const checkout = `~/repos/everythingpath`; // flagged
const homeRelative = '~/notes'; // flagged
const interpolated = `${base}/home/me`; // flagged
const gitPath = 'abcdef1:src/a.ts'; // flagged
const escapedGitPath = `\x61bcdef1:src/a.ts`; // flagged
const gitPathTemplate = `abcdef1:${file}`; // flagged
const fixturePath = 'tests/fixtures/home.json';
const scratch = `${tmpdir()}/probe`;
// Residual: a path split across interpolations has no literal part that
// names it, so the rule cannot see it without evaluating the template.
const split = `/ho${''}me/me/repo`;
